notes_for_editor: Thin record: no built year, design, height, staffing or fate in any source read, so the story stops at location and today's ski area. The record's local_unit 'Cariboo Regional District' is not in any source read and is left out of the story. The TRIM symbol (27368) polygon centroid (51.904689, -121.260095) is about 110 m from the Mount Timothy names point (fact-check 2026-10-20, our calculation); the Wikipedia ski-area coordinates are about 1.3 km from the TRIM symbol (our calculation), so the lookout is not confirmed to be on the ski-area land. Search results mixed in Big Timothy Mountain (Cariboo Land District, 52.10 N, 120.93 W per the names database), a different peak, and it is not used. The Canada Lookouts Timothy page is an index entry with no detail.
